title: Blazorators home
summary: Source-generated, strongly typed browser APIs for Blazor.
content: Explore storage, location, speech, exhaustive DOM interop, focused capability packages, live demos, and setup guides.

title: Local storage
summary: Persist a typed todo collection through window.localStorage.
content: Use ILocalStorageService to save, read, and remove JSON values without handwritten JavaScript glue.

title: Geolocation
summary: Resolve the current browser position and display it on a vector map.
content: Use source-generated geolocation bindings, typed coordinates, browser permissions, MapLibre, and OpenFreeMap.

title: Watch position
summary: Subscribe to live geolocation updates with a disposable callback.
content: Track movement, inspect event timing, stop the watcher, and preserve typed browser error results.

title: Text-to-speech
summary: Speak text with the browser Speech Synthesis API.
content: Choose a voice, set rate and pitch, pause, resume, and cancel browser-owned speech.

title: Speech-to-text
summary: Capture live transcripts through the Web Speech API.
content: Start and stop recognition, inspect typed results, and handle browser permission or support failures.

title: Audio lab
summary: Experiment with speech recognition controls and live audio feedback.
content: Use accessible microphone controls, status announcements, and a browser-backed recognition session.

title: Sandbox
summary: Try callback-style geolocation in a compact browser API playground.
content: Inspect success and error payloads and render the selected location on the shared map stack.

title: DOM API lab
summary: Run the exhaustive generated DOM surface in a real browser.
content: Exercise Window, Document, Performance, Crypto, Storage, Media Devices, events, unions, callbacks, and live-reference transport.

title: DOM capability catalog
summary: Browse focused packages for fourteen browser capability profiles.
content: Compare package roots, generated operations, projected symbols, browser requirements, setup, and live workflows.

title: Permissions
summary: Query typed browser permission state without triggering a prompt.
content: Inspect PermissionState values, PermissionDescriptor options, generated roots, and state change subscriptions.

title: Clipboard
summary: Write text and verify a real system clipboard round trip.
content: Use navigator.clipboard, typed Promise transport, clipboard permissions, copy, paste, and exact value verification.

title: Web Share
summary: Validate a typed payload and open the platform share sheet.
content: Use navigator.canShare, navigator.share, ShareData dictionaries, secure context, and user activation.

title: Wake Lock
summary: Keep the display awake with an owned, disposable sentinel.
content: Request and release a screen WakeLockSentinel while preserving live proxy identity and release events.

title: Storage management
summary: Inspect origin usage, quota, persistence, and private storage.
content: Use navigator.storage estimate, persisted, persist, and origin private file system APIs.

title: Screen
summary: Read display geometry and typed orientation state.
content: Compare screen dimensions with viewport dimensions and observe orientation changes.

title: Performance
summary: Measure work with the browser high-resolution monotonic clock.
content: Use performance.now, marks, entries, observers, navigation timing, and resource timing.

title: Web Crypto
summary: Generate secure UUIDs and run typed SubtleCrypto operations.
content: Use crypto.randomUUID, random values, SHA-256 digest, BufferSource transport, and live CryptoKey proxies.

title: Credentials and WebAuthn
summary: Preserve credential and authenticator response identity.
content: Use Credential Management, passkeys, WebAuthn, preventSilentAccess, typed request options, and binary authenticator data.

title: Offline storage
summary: Use Cache Storage and IndexedDB with browser-owned objects.
content: Create, inspect, and delete named caches while retaining typed IndexedDB requests and structured clone boundaries.

title: Browser coordination
summary: Coordinate tabs with Web Locks, BroadcastChannel, and visibility.
content: Inspect held and pending locks, own channel lifecycle, and subscribe to messages and page visibility.

title: Media devices
summary: Enumerate cameras and microphones with typed live ownership.
content: Use navigator.mediaDevices, enumerateDevices, streams, tracks, constraints, settings, and privacy-redacted labels.

title: Notifications
summary: Request permission and create a typed browser notification.
content: Author a title and body, inspect NotificationPermission, and own notification lifecycle events.

title: File System Access
summary: Choose a local file and preview images, PDFs, source code, or text.
content: Use showOpenFilePicker with owned handles, File and Blob reads, syntax highlighting, embedded media previews, metadata, and safe size limits.
